subject.title: fix(signal): restore native replies for Signal sends

question: Should this PR land the Signal-only `replyToId` alias and bounded group reply-author persistence without a live Signal device round trip?
rationale: The patch stays inside the Signal plugin boundary and I found no concrete code defect, but native message delivery semantics, bounded persisted sender metadata, and proof sufficiency are maintainer-owned choices.

options.title: Accept Signal-Scoped Contract
options.body: Merge after final maintainer review if the Signal-owned alias and seven-day bounded group sender lookup are the intended delivery contract.

options.title: Require Live Signal Smoke
options.body: Hold merge until someone runs a real Signal daemon/device quote-reply send and captures redacted proof of native visual quote behavior.

options.title: Defer To Broader Quote Direction
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want a broader bidirectional quote-reply design to own this behavior instead of the focused Signal repair.

recommendation.title: Accept Signal-Scoped Contract
recommendation.body: Merge after final maintainer review if the Signal-owned alias and seven-day bounded group sender lookup are the intended delivery contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history shows broad adjacent ownership of Signal channel routing, inbound context, and plugin SDK boundary work, making this the best available routing candidate for the merge-risk call.
